ModMetaData.name: GlyphFix
ModMetaData.author: SleepSheep
ModMetaData.description: Repairs four rendering defects of the Waylith Android port: blank build-menu icons (uiIcon resolved to BadTex through an unrenderable CutoutComplexUI material); the empty gizmo box beside Draft (Misc/GrayscaleGUI is not registered in this port, so disabled-command icons were drawn through the default shader); masked DLC art that drew blank or drew its own mask (double-extension content keys broke every mask lookup, and let masks into Graphic_Collection's variant list); and items whose own instance graphic has no usable texture (GetIconFor(Thing, ...) is instance level only, so the icon fell back to def.uiIcon, then to the def graphic, with the broken out material dropped). Steady-state cost 16.7 ns per patched call.
